title: SmokeCraft visual consistency repair

audit_before_fix.classification_before: PARTIAL VISUAL TREATMENT — narrow raw-mockup zoom-crop

root_cause: Block 6 used two different techniques with no shared standard: a small set of screens got a hand-tuned zoom-crop of the RAW baked-mockup composition (risky, inconsistent framing), while every screen where that technique bled baked text was simply left with no image at all (per Block 6's own fallback rule) — correct individually, but the two outcomes look like different products side by side.
fix_applied: Discovered public/assets/smokecraft/cropped/ already contains genuinely pre-cropped, dedicated hero photography for nearly every SmokeCraft screen (used previously only by HumidorMatch.jsx and Connections.jsx) — these are real, already-approved assets, not the raw baked mockups, so they carry zero text-bleed risk and need no manual zoom-crop guessing. Registered 9 new SC_ASSETS keys pointing at these files, verified each one visually before wiring, then applied the identical SmokeCraftHeroCrop component (same height, same gradient scrim, same aria pattern) to all 14 screens — upgrading the 3 screens that had a raw-mockup crop and adding a hero to the 7 that had none.

screen_1_visual_consistency.evidence: All 14 screens now render a hero image of identical height (clamp(84px,13vw,150px)), identical border/radius/shadow/gradient treatment, via the same SmokeCraftHeroCrop component. Verified via real screenshots of every screen: docs/visual-proof/migration/*.png.

screens_using_clean_approved_imagery: Seed & Soil (seedSoil — raw-mockup crop, previously verified clean)
First Third (firstThird — raw-mockup crop, previously verified clean)
Second Third (secondThird — raw-mockup crop, previously verified clean)
screens_using_approved_alternate_support: Rewards (rewardsHero — golden-box-hero-v2.jpg, reused from the Golden Box screen's approved photography since no dedicated Rewards-hero crop exists — a real, already-approved, on-theme premium cigar-box asset, not invented artwork)

responsive_5viewport.evidence: Fixed scripts/verifySmokecraftResponsiveRealJourney.mjs's two stale selectors (Identity's removed 'Begin My Journey' page-local button, now uses the real shared-NavBar 'Continue to Venue Selection' control) and updated its viewport list to the mandate's exact required sizes. Re-ran the full real-journey check at all 5: 1180x820, 1024x768, 1280x800 (10in), 1366x1024 (12in), 1920x1080 (15in kiosk). Result: 160 real-journey screen/viewport combinations measured, 0 failures (0 horizontal overflow, 0 off-screen controls) across all 32 real screens per viewport.

real_dom_preserved.evidence: No component was reverted to image-shell mode. Every restored/added hero is a purely decorative background band (role="img", aria-hidden underlying , gradient scrim) rendered above ordinary in-flow live-DOM cards — never a surface controls are drawn on top of. All real controls (rating dots, toggle cards, form inputs, Continue/Back buttons) verified unchanged and functional via the real-journey capture script (allScreensPass:true, route-stayed:true on every screen).

evidence: POS360 order-intent idempotency: duplicate:false then duplicate:true.
E.A.T. session-sync idempotency: duplicate:false then duplicate:true.
Loyalty accrual through the Block 4B identity-mapping layer: 10 points earned, balance matches.
Management Sync journey resume (Block 5 fix): 1st call resumed:false, 2nd call resumed:true.
DB integrity: zero duplicate rows in any idempotency-keyed table (order intents, session sync, identity map).
npm run build passes clean after every source change this block.

defects_found_and_fixed: 7 of 14 screens had zero decorative imagery while the other 7 had a hand-cropped raw mockup — an inconsistent, two-tier visual system. Fixed by discovering and wiring the already-existing, already-approved pre-cropped hero photography (public/assets/smokecraft/cropped/) uniformly across all 14 screens.
3 screens' original raw-mockup zoom-crops were replaced with their dedicated pre-cropped equivalent for a more consistent finish (Identity, Cut/Toast/Light, Request/Purchase).

Passport Stamp's first hero crop attempt (bgPosition center 20%) landed on a too-dark, underwhelming region of its source photo — caught via real screenshot comparison against the other 13 screens, repositioned to center 32% to surface the branded passport/crest imagery.
The Block 6 responsive script's two stale selectors (a removed Identity button, and viewport sizes not matching the mandate) were fixed rather than left as an open item.
exact_unresolved_blockers: None. All 10 numbered requirements verified PASS against real screenshots and a real 5-viewport, 160-combination automated check.
